reviewed_revision: V30 · local identity and continuity polish · final frozen optimized proof
scope: Language-development-informed editorial review of all 32 story captions, balloon dialogue, pacing and digital readability, covering all 34 pages including local identity derivatives of the owner-selected cover compositions. This is not clinical approval, creative owner acceptance or all-art/master-audit acceptance.

evidence.pdf_optimization_note: Final losslessly optimized PDF inspected directly. The current verification receipt reports all 34 rendered pages pixel-identical to the frozen PNGs; its PDF and book/provenance hashes were checked against the actual files. Native text, embedded Sniglet and trim were independently rechecked by this language audit.

coverage.method_note: All five changed V30 pages (0, 4, 5, 10, 33) were directly inspected at native PNG size; final page 5 with both sponges received an additional freeze inspection. Other 29 PNGs are byte-identical to the final V29 proof and reuse its complete visual-language review. The only caption change is page 5; all current PDF text and page/font/trim evidence were checked against current provenance.

native_type_verification.unused_helvetica_resource_note: ReportLab retains a default Helvetica resource; no nonempty text run uses it.

operational_age4_5_rubric.criterion: Each helping episode supplies a problem, action and result in text/picture together.
operational_age4_5_rubric.evidence: Pages 4–16, 17–20, 21–22 and 23–30 retain coherent episodes; the clearing action on 12 is narrated.

operational_age4_5_rubric.criterion: Introduce names/roles and make dialogue attribution or balloon speakers identifiable.
operational_age4_5_rubric.evidence: Rumi 10–11, Baby Eagle 18, Puff 24; Roshan attributions 3–4/19–20/25; two distinct balloon speakers 20.

operational_age4_5_rubric.criterion: Concrete new nouns/actions are pictured or explained; any metaphor follows a visible referent.
operational_age4_5_rubric.evidence: Brush and both sponge shapes are pictured on page 5; fountain, streams and rainbow are supported. Centuries and the rainbow metaphor remain adult-supported shared-reading language rather than prescribed child number/decoding expectations.

operational_age4_5_rubric.criterion: Keep grammatical language, brief idea groups and phrase-preserving line breaks.
operational_age4_5_rubric.evidence: All captions have 2–4 deliberate lines; attribution 4 remains intact. No arbitrary child vocabulary ceiling or diagnostic readability formula is used.

operational_age4_5_rubric.criterion: Differentiate playful intention and unintended impact; show apology, guidance, reassurance and helping.
operational_age4_5_rubric.evidence: Pages 18–20 and 24–31 make these relationships explicit; Puff is cleaned with friends.

operational_age4_5_rubric.criterion: Use natural repetition and voluntary participation without requiring reading or an answer.
operational_age4_5_rubric.evidence: I’ll help, scoop, scrub and sound refrains recur. A real full adult read-aloud remains pending.

operational_age4_5_rubric.criterion: Require embedded native Sniglet caption/dialogue ≥18 pt, unclipped outlines, deliberate lines and readable digital contrast.
operational_age4_5_rubric.evidence: 34 pages at 504 × 360 pt; embedded native story type is 18–20 pt; actual glyph insets remain at least 24 pt including fine contours. Native text shows exactly match provenance; inherited cover-title top inset 19.32 pt is disclosed separately.

operational_age4_5_rubric.criterion: Keep readable native text inside rounded capsules, tails directed to small speakers and no key-character overlap.
operational_age4_5_rubric.evidence: Page 20: 18 pt text, recorded insets ≥8.095 pt vertically and ≥33.608 pt horizontally; no clipping or Eagle overlap.

operational_age4_5_rubric.criterion: Named objects, two-bunny rescue, stream states and care actions must agree with visible art.
operational_age4_5_rubric.evidence: Cup 14 and brushing 19 are visible; exactly two bunnies on 18; actual stream clearing between source states is narrated.

operational_age4_5_rubric.criterion: Maintain episode/payoff rhythm and a calm inclusive close; marginal play remains secondary.
operational_age4_5_rubric.evidence: Episode/payoff rhythm is intact. Print plan separates covers from 32 interiors so story 1 starts on the right and 23→24/27→28 are actual turns. A real print dummy and child observation remain separate acceptance.

page_reviews.label: front_cover
page_reviews.wording:
Mermaid Roshan
and the Hidden Rainbow
A Pearl Castle friendship story
page_reviews.observed_result: Local identity derivatives preserve the rendered cover composition. The title/subtitle remain native type in the quiet sky; the ensemble, cleaning supplies and peeking Puff support the same story.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: Cover names the story and provides an ensemble introduction without adding plot or independent-reading demands.

page_reviews.label: story_01
page_reviews.wording:
“Look, Daddy!
Pearl Castle!”
page_reviews.observed_result: White quotation has a thin navy contour and remains clear in the quiet scene region; no face or important castle feature is covered.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: Direct address and a named destination establish excitement and the Daddy–Roshan relationship.

page_reviews.label: story_02
page_reviews.wording:
Roshan and Daddy landed at Sky Lagoon.
Pearl Castle was close by.
page_reviews.observed_result: Navy caption on pale sky is clear; setting and arrival are explicit.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: Arrival and castle location are explicit; proper names recur in the next episode.

text_lines.text: Roshan and Daddy landed at Sky Lagoon.

page_reviews.label: story_03
page_reviews.wording:
“Let’s look inside,
Daddy,” said Roshan.
page_reviews.observed_result: Two native 18 pt navy quotation lines sit on the lower-right lavender floor at x268 in a 206 pt caption region. Both phrases fit. The actor/fin envelope and all corrected focal boxes remain clear; the fin-to-caption horizontal gap is 12 pt.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: The invitation to enter supplies the cause for the interior page turn; said Roshan identifies the speaker.

page_reviews.label: story_04
page_reviews.wording:
Inside, dust covered the floor.
“Let’s clean it together!”
said Roshan.
page_reviews.observed_result: Local facial expression refinements retain the dirty hall, actor staging and shared-cleaning promise. Three 18 pt white lines with fine navy contours remain clear on the lower-right floor.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: The dirty floor establishes the shared problem and the proposal to clean it together.

page_reviews.label: story_05
page_reviews.wording:
Daddy gave her a brush and some sponges.
“One little job at a time.”
page_reviews.observed_result: The final supply page clearly pictures one brush and both a pink star sponge and a yellow sponge as true isolated cutouts. The plural caption is now immediately supported, and both native 18 pt lines fit in quiet blue space without covering tools or marginal characters.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: Concrete brush/sponges nouns are pictured. Naming the supplies as a set accounts for later different sponge shapes/colors without adding a story event. One little job at a time still introduces the episodic helping rhythm.

text_lines.text: Daddy gave her a brush and some sponges.

page_reviews.label: story_06
page_reviews.wording:
A dust bunny splashed in the dirty bath.
It loved to play. Splash, splash!
page_reviews.observed_result: Playful bunny and splash refrain match the bath. The final caption field retains natural continuous tile and grout detail without a hard-edged panel; fine navy contours keep the white words distinct in the digital proof.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: A dust bunny is introduced through an observable playful action. Splash repetition invites voluntary participation.

text_lines.text: A dust bunny splashed in the dirty bath.
It loved to play. Splash, splash!

page_reviews.label: story_07
page_reviews.wording:
Round and round went the sponge.
Roshan wiped the sink clean.
page_reviews.observed_result: Circular sponge contact and sink cleaning are visible; caption is distinct in blue writing space.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: Circular action and the clean sink result are concrete; the sponge links to the earlier named tool.

text_lines.text: Round and round went the sponge.

page_reviews.label: story_08
page_reviews.wording:
Roshan let the dirty bath water out.
Then she scrubbed the tub. Scrub, scrub!
page_reviews.observed_result: Empty bath and brush contact support the then sequence; two-line caption is clear.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: Then makes the drainage-before-scrubbing order explicit; scrub is repeated in a natural action context.

text_lines.text: Roshan let the dirty bath water out.
Then she scrubbed the tub. Scrub, scrub!

page_reviews.label: story_09
page_reviews.wording:
Clean water filled the bath.
The dust bunny splashed again!
page_reviews.observed_result: Clean water payoff is visible and type remains distinct; no text prompt accompanies decorative discoveries.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: Clean water provides a visible payoff; the bunny remains playful rather than being punished.

page_reviews.label: story_10
page_reviews.wording:
A mermaid named Rumi was stuck
under the gunk in the pool.
page_reviews.observed_result: Rumi’s local face refinement keeps her visibly trapped under the same pool gunk, with rubbish net and blocked fountain preserved. Caption and depicted problem still agree.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: Rumi is introduced by name and category with a visible, present-tense problem.

text_lines.text: A mermaid named Rumi was stuck
under the gunk in the pool.

page_reviews.label: story_11
page_reviews.wording:
Rumi had lived in Pearl Castle
for hundreds of years.
“I’ll help!” said Roshan. Scoop, scoop!
page_reviews.observed_result: Three-line wording clearly identifies Rumi and her centuries of residence, without assigning that duration to her entrapment. The rubbish net supports the helping action.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: Past residence is distinct from the current problem. Hundreds of years is a fantasy-context phrase for adult-supported shared reading, not an expected child number concept.

text_lines.text: Rumi had lived in Pearl Castle

page_reviews.label: story_12
page_reviews.wording:
One stream ran clear.
Then Roshan cleared the other two.
page_reviews.observed_result: One orange clear lane and two green obstructed lanes support the explicit one/other-two progression. The intervening clearing action is narrated rather than directly illustrated.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: One, then and other two support a simple count-and-action sequence. Roshan is named rather than implied.

text_lines.text: Then Roshan cleared the other two.

page_reviews.label: story_13
page_reviews.wording:
All three streams were clear.
Whoosh! The waterfall turned rainbow!
page_reviews.observed_result: All three rainbow streams provide a clear payoff. The quieter lower water and thin navy contour make the white 20 pt caption distinct.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: All three and turned rainbow close the stream episode with a visible result and a sound refrain.

page_reviews.label: story_14
page_reviews.wording:
A cup was stuck in the seahorse fountain.
Roshan pulled it free!
page_reviews.observed_result: Pink cup is visible in Roshan’s hands; open seahorse mouth flows. The caption introduces the object/location and states removal.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: The cup and seahorse fountain are named before the removal result; the cup is visible in Roshan’s hands.

text_lines.text: A cup was stuck in the seahorse fountain.

page_reviews.label: story_15
page_reviews.wording:
Fresh water flowed. The gunk was gone.
Up came Rumi. She was free!
page_reviews.observed_result: Clear water and Rumi rising support the freedom payoff. Thin navy contours keep the white caption readable on the lower purple floor. The final 2 pt caption inset adjustment preserves readability and clears the 24 pt story glyph-margin target, including contour.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: Fresh water, no gunk and Rumi rising connect cleanup with freedom in an explicit cause-and-result sequence.

text_lines.text: Fresh water flowed. The gunk was gone.
Up came Rumi. She was free!

page_reviews.label: story_16
page_reviews.wording:
“You helped me!”
said Rumi.
She gave Roshan
a great big hug.
page_reviews.observed_result: Gratitude attribution and affectionate hug align; left caption and right connected action group are distinct.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: Gratitude attribution is explicit; a great big hug supplies a warm social payoff.

page_reviews.label: story_17
page_reviews.wording:
Chirp, chirp!
“Someone needs help!” said Roshan.
page_reviews.observed_result: Roshan’s listening gesture supports the chirp and help quotation. Page 18 now explicitly names the playroom, resolving the previously unmarked location transition.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: The chirp invites the next helping episode without prematurely describing its solution.

page_reviews.label: story_18
page_reviews.wording:
In the playroom, two dust bunnies sat on Baby Eagle.
They wanted to play, but he was stuck.
page_reviews.observed_result: Exactly two puffs sit on Eagle’s wings. The two-line native 18 pt caption names the playroom and distinguishes playful intent from being stuck. Lowered baseline y62 clears the 80 pt focal threshold: first-line glyph top is 79.208 pt, leaving 0.792 pt recorded-envelope clearance; no actor is covered in the native proof.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: The playroom cue locates the scene change. Exactly two bunnies, playful intent and Eagle’s discomfort are all explicit; sat on is literal rather than implying deliberate restraint.

text_lines.text: In the playroom, two dust bunnies sat on Baby Eagle.
They wanted to play, but he was stuck.

page_reviews.label: story_19
page_reviews.wording:
“I’ll help!” said Roshan.
She gently brushed one bunny away, then the other.
page_reviews.observed_result: Brush contacts a puff while Eagle stands free with open wings; gently accurately frames the help. Two lines remain unclipped.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: Gently frames brush use as care. One, then the other supports the two-bunny sequence without violent language.

text_lines.text: She gently brushed one bunny away, then the other.

page_reviews.label: story_20
page_reviews.wording:
Baby Eagle was free!
“Let’s play gently,” said Roshan.
page_reviews.observed_result: Caption supplies explicit gentle-play guidance. Rounded speech capsules have generous text padding; each curved tail clearly points to its small bunny and avoids Eagle.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: Freedom, apology and the gentle-play invitation repair the accidental harm. Dialogue explains intent while Roshan supplies a clear, supportive next action.

page_reviews.label: story_21
page_reviews.wording:
Brushes here. Paints there.
Roshan put each thing in its place.
page_reviews.observed_result: Brush/paint sorting matches the caption. Navy type sits in quiet blue writing space; the action and the following clean-room payoff retain a short, coherent sequence.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: Concrete sorting language ties the art-room picture to cleaning rather than introducing an unrelated craft plot.

text_lines.text: Roshan put each thing in its place.

page_reviews.label: story_22
page_reviews.wording:
Scrub, scrub! The table was clean.
Everything was back in its place.
page_reviews.observed_result: Clean table and brush contact form a quick payoff. Caption stays below the story art in the floor space.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: The clean table and everything in its place give this short cleanup episode a clear payoff.

text_lines.text: Scrub, scrub! The table was clean.
Everything was back in its place.

page_reviews.label: story_23
page_reviews.wording:
One last door began to glow.
A rumble came from behind it...
page_reviews.observed_result: Glowing final door, completed door markers and route lights support last/behind. Navy caption is distinct on pale upper wall. The final 2 pt caption inset adjustment preserves readability and clears the 24 pt story glyph-margin target, including contour.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: One last door and behind provide a spatial cue and a controlled anticipation page turn.

text_lines.text: One last door began to glow.
A rumble came from behind it...

page_reviews.label: story_24
page_reviews.wording:
Grand Puff!
He was so dusty.
He did not feel well.
page_reviews.observed_result: Unwell Puff’s face supports discomfort language. Small frightened border bunnies remain secondary to the main figure.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: Puff is named and uncomfortable rather than villainized. So dusty and did not feel well set up care.

page_reviews.label: story_25
page_reviews.wording:
“Hold on, we’ll make you feel
clean and better!” said Roshan.
page_reviews.observed_result: Owner-exact reassurance remains; soapy yellow sponge clearly communicates care. Caption is clean and unobstructed.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: Owner-approved reassurance explicitly promises feeling clean and better. The cleaning supply in Roshan’s hands makes the intention visible.

page_reviews.label: story_26
page_reviews.wording:
Daddy, Rumi, and Baby Eagle helped Roshan.
Together, they washed Grand Puff. Scrub, scrub!
page_reviews.observed_result: Four named helpers visibly wash smiling Puff. Together and the sound refrain communicate cooperative care. White type has a thin navy contour and avoids the faces. The final 2 pt caption inset adjustment preserves readability and clears the 24 pt story glyph-margin target, including contour.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: Names and Together unambiguously identify cooperative helpers; washed and scrub communicate cleaning.

text_lines.text: Daddy, Rumi, and Baby Eagle helped Roshan.
Together, they washed Grand Puff. Scrub, scrub!

page_reviews.label: story_27
page_reviews.wording:
Soft bubbles covered Grand Puff.
Under the bubbles, his colors began to shine.
page_reviews.observed_result: Words and bubble concealment retain the anticipated reveal. The PNG is byte-identical to the final V29 proof; that proof’s independent style_final.json closes STY-V29-05. This language audit records that closure by reference rather than issuing new art approval.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: Soft bubbles and colors began to shine prepare the reveal with concrete visual support.

text_lines.text: Under the bubbles, his colors began to shine.

page_reviews.label: story_28
page_reviews.wording:
POP! Grand Puff sprang out, rainbow bright!
The dust fell away.
page_reviews.observed_result: Airborne rainbow Puff supports POP and sprang. The thin navy contour preserves white-letter separation without covering faces. The final 2 pt caption inset adjustment preserves readability and clears the 24 pt story glyph-margin target, including contour.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: POP and sprang convey the joyful reveal; dust falling away explains the change without attack or defeat.

text_lines.text: POP! Grand Puff sprang out, rainbow bright!

page_reviews.label: story_29
page_reviews.wording:
Down came Grand Puff, soft and small.
He felt like himself again.
page_reviews.observed_result: The retained canonical landing depicts Puff soft and small; recovery wording matches. White caption contours improve separation from the ceiling. The final 2 pt caption inset adjustment preserves readability and clears the 24 pt story glyph-margin target, including contour.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: Soft and small gives a concrete outcome before felt like himself again supplies a simple recovery meaning.

text_lines.text: Down came Grand Puff, soft and small.

page_reviews.label: story_30
page_reviews.wording:
“Your rainbow was there all along,
Grand Puff. We helped it shine!”
page_reviews.observed_result: Roshan faces the visible rainbow Puff; metaphor follows the concrete reveal. Main figures and caption are separated.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: The rainbow metaphor follows the visible reveal. We helped it shine credits care while preserving Puff’s own identity.

text_lines.text: Grand Puff. We helped it shine!”

page_reviews.label: story_31
page_reviews.wording:
“Come and play, Baby Eagle!”
The little dust bunnies played gently, too.
page_reviews.observed_result: Eagle approaches the invitation; two small puffs play with toys. Readable caption gives a gentle bridge into the nap.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: The invitation and played gently demonstrate the earlier guidance in the happy ending.

text_lines.text: The little dust bunnies played gently, too.

page_reviews.wording:

page_reviews.observed_result: Five main friends and two little puffs rest in bubbles. The inclusive closing words are clear against the subdued upper wall, with thin navy contours. The final 2 pt caption inset adjustment preserves readability and clears the 24 pt story glyph-margin target, including contour.
page_reviews.semantic_pacing_review: Room for everyone and curled up together provide inclusion and a calm bedtime close.
